description: This file contains utility functions related to system information retrieval, license management, update checks, and configuration handling for SuiteCRM. It includes functions for gathering system info, version comparison, license loading, and update configuration management.

methods.name: getSystemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves comprehensive system information, including version data, server environment, user counts, and active metrics, optionally including usage data.

methods.name: getBaseSystemInfo
methods.description: Collects base system information such as SugarCRM version, flavor, and database version.

methods.name: check_now
methods.description: Performs a system check and communicates with the license server for validation, including version checks and remote updates.

methods.name: compareVersions
methods.description: Compares two version strings and returns true if the first is greater than the second.

methods.name: set_CheckUpdates_config_setting
methods.description: Sets the configuration setting for automatic update checks.

methods.name: get_CheckUpdates_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the current configuration setting for update checks, creating it with default if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: set_last_check_version_config_setting
methods.description: Records the last checked version for updates in configuration.

methods.name: get_last_check_version_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the last checked version from configuration.

methods.name: set_last_check_date_config_setting
methods.description: Stores the date of the last check for updates.

methods.name: get_last_check_date_config_setting
methods.description: Retrieves the date of the last update check.

methods.name: set_sugarbeat
methods.description: Stores a value related to SugarCRM's heartbeat configuration.

methods.name: get_sugarbeat
methods.description: Retrieves the current heartbeat configuration value.

methods.name: shouldCheckSugar
methods.description: Determines if the system should perform automatic update checks based on configuration.

methods.name: loadLicense
methods.description: Loads license information into global scope, optionally for first login.

methods.name: loginLicense
methods.description: Performs license validation, checking for updates and version compatibility, and sets appropriate session variables.
